name: entry
objective: Repair root provenance: return the whole entry span, including keyword/name/colon, rather than only the value capture.
contract: Read UTF-8 source from argv[1]. Output exactly one JSON object. Success: {ok:true,value:integer,start:byte_offset,end:exclusive_byte_offset} for the whole root; failure: {ok:false}. Ignore ASCII whitespace and default // line and /* block */ comments, except invoice uses only # line comments. Consume all tokens. Inputs <=4096 bytes, signed integers and results fit i64. Strings are closed, double quoted ASCII identifiers without escapes; no malformed strings/comments, embedded NUL, or non-ASCII identifiers are in scope.
